health_cutline.description: Subjects at or above Stable carry the cleared upstream-health claim; an upstream-health gap on a still-stable subject holds promotion through the shiproom gate.

rules.title: Maintainer base must not thin to a bus-factor risk
rules.rationale: An upstream-health failure on a subject still claiming a label at or above the cutline holds promotion through the shiproom gate; inherited (below-cutline or waived) narrowings are gated upstream.

records.title: Framework async-runtime upstream
records.subject_summary: A healthy, well-maintained async runtime with a clean security posture, an active release cadence, a current review, a clear license, an assigned owner, and no contingency or escalation outstanding.
records.rationale: Maintainer health, security posture, cadence, review, license, ownership, and proof all hold, so the upstream is green and the scan and surface agree on a clean posture.

records.title: Framework wire-protocol upstream
records.subject_summary: A stable wire protocol whose release cadence is slowing and whose next review is coming due; both are surfaced as reminders without narrowing the still-healthy upstream.
records.rationale: A slowing cadence and a coming-due review are reminders, not gaps: the maintainer base, security posture, license, and ownership all hold, so the upstream stays cleared and green.

records.title: Notebook render-kernel upstream
records.subject_summary: A render kernel whose upstream has been abandoned by its maintainers; a replace-dependency plan is recorded and the shiproom has been told, but the maintainer collapse narrows the still-stable claim.
records.rationale: Upstream-health failure: the maintainer base has collapsed to abandoned while the family still claims Stable, so the maintainer gap holds promotion even though a replacement plan is recorded and the shiproom escalation is raised.

records.title: Data-rich columnar-core upstream
records.subject_summary: A columnar engine carrying an unpatched critical advisory; an owner, a sponsor plan, and a raised escalation are in place, but the open critical narrows the still-stable claim.
records.rationale: Upstream-health failure: an unpatched critical advisory is open while the family still claims Stable, so the security gap holds promotion until the vulnerability is patched.

records.title: AI-adjacent model-runtime curated import
records.subject_summary: A curated model runtime whose upstream has stopped shipping releases; the maintainer base and security posture are otherwise fine, but the stalled cadence narrows the still-stable claim.
records.rationale: Upstream-health failure: the update cadence has stalled while the family still claims Stable, so the cadence gap holds promotion until the upstream resumes or a replacement is found.

records.title: Review diff-protocol upstream
records.subject_summary: A diff protocol whose quarterly upstream-health review is overdue; the review lane is already Beta, so the overdue review is gated upstream.
records.rationale: The upstream-health review is overdue; the lane is already Beta, so this cadence narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion, but the overdue review is surfaced as a reminder.

records.title: Companion UI-toolkit upstream
records.subject_summary: A UI toolkit whose effective license is ambiguous after an upstream relicensing; the maintainer base and security posture are fine, but the license ambiguity narrows the still-stable claim.
records.rationale: Upstream-health failure: the upstream license is ambiguous while the family still claims Stable, so the license gap holds promotion until the license is clarified.

records.title: Managed-depth object-store upstream
records.subject_summary: An object-store client treated as infrastructure plumbing and left without an assigned owner; the shiproom escalation is raised, but the unowned protected-path dependency narrows the still-stable claim.
records.rationale: Upstream-health failure: a critical upstream was left unowned because it is 'just infrastructure' while the family still claims Stable, so the ownership gap holds promotion until an owner is assigned, even though the shiproom escalation is raised.

records.title: AI-adjacent vector-index upstream
records.subject_summary: A red-risk vector-index engine with an open advisory that is unowned, has no recorded sponsor/fork/replace plan, and has not been raised to the shiproom — the headline guardrail case on a still-stable claim.
records.rationale: Upstream-health failure: a red-risk dependency is unowned, has no approved sponsor/fork/replace plan, and has not been escalated to the shiproom while the family still claims Stable, so the ownership/escalation gap holds promotion — a red-risk dependency may not widen a stable claim without an approved plan.

records.title: Framework build-toolchain upstream
records.subject_summary: A healthy build toolchain whose upstream-health proof packet has aged past its freshness SLO; the toolchain lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: The upstream is healthy but its health proof packet is stale; the lane is already Beta, so this evidence-staleness narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Companion packager upstream
records.subject_summary: A healthy packager toolchain with no captured upstream-health proof packet; the companion lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: No upstream-health proof packet has been captured; the lane is already Beta, so this evidence-staleness narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Review grammar-pack upstream
records.subject_summary: A healthy grammar pack whose health record still lacks an owner sign-off; the review lane is already Beta.
records.rationale: The health record carries no owner sign-off; the lane is already Beta, so this evidence-staleness narrowing is gated upstream and does not hold promotion.

records.title: Data-rich stats-kernel curated import
records.subject_summary: A healthy curated stats kernel whose relied-on health waiver has expired; the data-rich curated lane is already Beta.

waiver.reason: An upstream-health re-assessment was time-boxed under this waiver, which has since expired and must be renewed or cleared.

records.rationale: The relied-on waiver has expired; the lane is already Beta, so this narrowing is gated upstream, but the expired waiver is surfaced rather than silently honored.

records.title: Managed-depth queue-protocol upstream
records.subject_summary: A queue protocol that has thinned to a single maintainer; a backup-maintainer search is time-boxed under a waiver, so the maintainer narrowing is gated upstream while the family still claims Stable.

waiver.reason: The upstream has thinned to a single maintainer; a backup-maintainer search and sponsorship are time-boxed under this waiver.

records.rationale: The maintainer base has thinned to a single maintainer, but an unexpired waiver holds the gap provisionally, so it is gated upstream and does not hold promotion while the search runs.

scan_surface_parity.rationale: The upstream-health scan and the governance-dashboard/promotion-packet surface agree on every subject, so a green upstream card can never mask an abandoned, unpatched, or unowned dependency.

publication.rationale: Hold while any release-blocking subject carries an upstream-health gap on a still-stable claim; inherited and waived narrowings are gated upstream. A red-risk or unowned protected-path dependency may not widen a stable claim without an approved sponsor, fork, or replacement plan.
